**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Kubient MSA imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching obligation on AP. Targeted searches ("solicit", "employ or engage", "induce/recruit/leave the employ", "no-hire", "non-compete") returned nothing, and a full read of all 75 paragraphs confirms the only personnel-related language is the mutual data-security covenant limiting database access to authorized personnel (p0035, p0045) and the independent-contractor clause (p0066). The General Provisions (p0063–p0073) carry no restrictive covenant, and the integration sentence in p0072 confirms no extrinsic terms import one.

This satisfies the preferred NOSOLICIT position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), so no redline was proposed. Watch point for future Exhibits: each Exhibit is incorporated as part of the Agreement (p0001), so any Exhibit-level non-solicit would need to be narrowed to the fallback (mutual, personnel directly involved in the Services, ≤12 months from end of involvement, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire).
